title: smix run report
description: Payload emitted by `smix run --format json` on stdout at exit + payload written to `--debug-output <dir>/run-summary.json`. Consumers should `JSON.parse` the entire stdout body (single top-level object).

flow.description: Path to the top-level yaml passed to `smix run`. Verbatim from CLI; may be absolute or relative.

runOutcome.description: Terminal outcome. `success` = every step returned Ok or Skipped and the flow reached its final step. `failure` = a step returned an error or the run bailed on parse/io/cycle. Non-fatal WARNs during the run do not change this.

warnings.description: Warning lines the run emitted (also on stderr). Common causes: graceful skip of unsupported subflow verbs, G10 clearState warns, missing runFlow files fallback.

error.description: Present when runOutcome=failure and the failure did NOT surface as an SDK ExpectationFailure (parse/io/cycle/etc.). Contains the stringified RunError.

failure.description: Present when runOutcome=failure AND the failure was an SDK ExpectationFailure — the AI-readable case. Wire shape mirrors the internal `smix-error::ExpectationFailure`.

code.description: FailureCode variant name, debug-formatted. Stable across smix versions. Common values: `ElementNotFound`, `Timeout`, `DriverError`, `NotImplemented`, `RunnerError`.

message.description: Human-readable failure summary (mirrors the top line of the stderr `to_prompt` block).

selector.description: Debug-formatted `Selector` variant when the failure was selector-scoped. `null` for non-selector failures (parse errors, driver errors, etc.).

suggestions.description: Ranked list of hint strings. Present for ElementNotFound (near-match testIDs by edit distance) and for expression errors (parser hints).

visibleCount.description: Number of visible A11yNode entries captured at failure. The full array is not inline in the JSON (would balloon typical response); it goes to `--debug-output/step-<N>-<verb>.json`'s a11y snapshot.
